# AVR Maestro

> AVR Maestro is an independent app for controlling Denon and Marantz AV receivers over your local network, on Android, iOS, macOS and Windows. It is made by MiyaraHub Technologies LLC and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Denon, Marantz, Sound United or Masimo Corporation.

AVR Maestro is an independent network remote for Denon and Marantz AV receivers. It talks to the receiver over your local network, with no account, no ads and no cloud service in between, and it shows only what your receiver model actually has.

Key facts:

- Features: one-tap Scenes, Home Assistant and Hubitat automation, speaker preset control, Audyssey and Dirac Live, multi-zone, an FM, AM and HD Radio tuner and a deep virtual remote, over your local network.
- Requirements: A network-enabled Denon or Marantz AV receiver on the same local network, with Network Control enabled on the receiver.
- Price: $9.99, paid once. No subscription and no ads. The optional Home Automation Pro add-on is $2.99.
- Platforms: iPhone and iPad, Mac, Android, and Windows.
- Maker: MiyaraHub Technologies LLC.
- Privacy: Crash reports, with network details masked, go to Firebase to help fix bugs. Usage statistics are opt-in. See the [privacy policy](https://www.miyarahub.com/privacy.html).
- Rating: 4.9 out of 5 from 330 store ratings (App Store 4.86 from 128 and Google Play 4.97 from 202), measured 2026-11-09.
- Receiver pages (20): Denon AVC-X8500HA, Denon AVR-A1H, Denon AVR-S770H, Denon AVR-S970H, Denon AVR-X1800H, Denon AVR-X2800H, Denon AVR-X3800H, Denon AVR-X4000, Denon AVR-X4500H, Denon AVR-X4800H, Denon AVR-X6800H, Marantz AV10, Marantz AV7706, Marantz AV8805, Marantz Cinema 30, Marantz Cinema 40 / 50 / 60, Marantz Cinema 50, Marantz SR5015, Marantz SR6015 and Marantz SR7015.
- Room correction: Audyssey control is named on 20 of 20 receiver pages; Dirac Live control on the Denon AVC-X8500HA, Denon AVR-A1H, Denon AVR-X3800H, Denon AVR-X4800H, Denon AVR-X6800H, Marantz AV10, Marantz AV8805, Marantz Cinema 30, Marantz Cinema 40 / 50 / 60, Marantz Cinema 50, Marantz SR6015 and Marantz SR7015 pages.
- Compatibility: AVR Maestro works with network-enabled Denon and Marantz AV receivers from roughly 2014 onward - including the Marantz Cinema 30, 40, 50 and 60, Denon AVR-A1H, AVR-X1800H through X6800H, AVC-X8500HA, AVR-S770H and S970H, and the Marantz SR and AV series. There is no model whitelist: AVR Maestro detects what your receiver supports when it connects, so if your receiver's web portal and the official Denon or Marantz app can reach it on your network, AVR Maestro can too.
- Languages: the site is in English plus 29 translations. This file lists English URLs only; a translated page is https://avrmaestro.com/<locale>/<path>, with <locale> one of ar, cs, da, de, el, es, fi, fr, he, hi, hu, id, it, ja, ko, nb, nl, pl, pt, pt-br, ro, ru, sv, th, tr, uk, vi, zh-hans, zh-hant.
- Denon, Marantz, HEOS, Audyssey, Dirac Live, Home Assistant, Hubitat, Alexa, App Store, Google Play and Microsoft Store are trademarks of their respective owners, used here only for identification.

## Product and comparison

- [Denon App and Marantz App: AV Receiver Remote](https://avrmaestro.com/): AVR Maestro is an independent remote app for Denon and Marantz AV receivers: one-tap Scenes, Audyssey and Dirac Live, speaker presets, multi-zone and more.
- [Best App for Denon & Marantz Receivers](https://avrmaestro.com/best-denon-marantz-app/): Want a better Denon or Marantz receiver app? AVR Maestro adds one-tap Scenes, Audyssey and Dirac Live, multi-zone and an FM/AM tuner. No ads, no subscriptions.
- [Audyssey App Alternative for Denon & Marantz](https://avrmaestro.com/audyssey-app-alternative/): Switch Audyssey MultEQ, Dynamic EQ, Dynamic Volume and LFC on your Denon or Marantz from your phone. See what AVR Maestro does, then get the app.
- [Control Audyssey & Dirac Live From Your Phone](https://avrmaestro.com/audyssey-dirac-control/): Switch Audyssey MultEQ, Dynamic EQ, Dynamic Volume, LFC and Dirac Live filter slots on your Denon or Marantz receiver from your phone with AVR Maestro.
- [Audyssey vs Dirac Live: Which Should You Use?](https://avrmaestro.com/audyssey-vs-dirac/): Audyssey vs Dirac Live on Denon and Marantz receivers: how the two room correction systems differ, which models support each, and how to switch between them.
- [Denon Receiver App for Android](https://avrmaestro.com/denon-app-for-android/): Looking for a Denon app for Android? AVR Maestro controls your Denon AV receiver from your Android phone or tablet: Scenes, Audyssey, Dirac Live and widgets.
- [Denon Receiver App for iPhone & iPad](https://avrmaestro.com/denon-app-for-iphone/): Looking for a Denon app for iPhone? AVR Maestro controls your Denon AV receiver from iPhone and iPad: Scenes, Audyssey, Dirac Live, zones and widgets. No ads.
- [Denon & Marantz App for Windows & Mac](https://avrmaestro.com/denon-marantz-app-windows-mac/): Control a Denon or Marantz receiver from your PC or Mac. AVR Maestro is on the Microsoft Store and Mac App Store, with keyboard shortcuts and media keys.
- [Marantz Receiver App for iPhone & iPad](https://avrmaestro.com/marantz-app-for-iphone/): Looking for a Marantz app for iPhone? AVR Maestro controls your Marantz receiver from iPhone and iPad: Scenes, Audyssey, Dirac Live, zones and widgets.

## Help and troubleshooting

- [Help & Troubleshooting for Denon & Marantz](https://avrmaestro.com/help/): AVR Maestro help: fix Test Connection failures, dropped connections, volume readouts, greyed-out controls and a blank Now Playing card, and send us your logs.
- [Denon or Marantz Receiver Not Found? Fix the Connection](https://avrmaestro.com/denon-receiver-not-found/): Your Denon or Marantz receiver is not found or will not connect? Check Network Control, the subnet, the IP address and busy-network errors, step by step.
- [Home Assistant Troubleshooting](https://avrmaestro.com/guide/home-assistant-troubleshooting/): Fix Home Assistant problems with AVR Maestro: what the link card means, Entity Not Found, scenes that do not appear and the Failed login log line.

## User guide

- [User Guide for Denon & Marantz Receivers](https://avrmaestro.com/guide/): The complete AVR Maestro user guide: set up, connect and use every screen, from Scenes and Sound to Speakers, Zones, Remote and Radio, on your Denon or Marantz.
- [Control a Denon or Marantz From Your Phone](https://avrmaestro.com/guide/getting-started/): Get started with AVR Maestro: a five-step welcome finds your Denon or Marantz receiver on your network, shows you around and builds your first Scene.
- [On-Device Assistant for Denon & Marantz](https://avrmaestro.com/guide/assistant/): The AVR Maestro assistant answers questions about your own Denon or Marantz receiver and can change settings for you, using a model that runs on your device.
- [Backup & Restore Settings to a New Phone](https://avrmaestro.com/guide/backup/): Export your AVR Maestro setup to one .zip file: receivers, Scenes, custom icons, input order, theme and volume settings. Restore it on a new phone in taps.
- [Custom Input & Scene Icons for Your Receiver](https://avrmaestro.com/guide/custom-icons/): Replace the stock input and Scene icons in AVR Maestro with your own artwork: pick any image, crop it with shape presets, and it shows on tiles and the Remote.
- [9-Band Graphic EQ for Denon & Marantz](https://avrmaestro.com/guide/graphic-eq/): Shape a 9-band Graphic EQ curve (63Hz to 16kHz) for every speaker on your Denon or Marantz from your phone: All, Left/Right or Each, then Apply.
- [Home Assistant Dashboard for Denon & Marantz](https://avrmaestro.com/guide/home-assistant-dashboard/): Build a Home Assistant dashboard for your Denon or Marantz receiver: HACS cards, entity IDs, YAML for every card, real dB volume, Scenes and history.
- [Home Assistant & Hubitat for Denon & Marantz](https://avrmaestro.com/guide/home-automation/): Link AVR Maestro to Home Assistant or Hubitat and your Scenes become native scripts that run without your phone. Voice control, live state and webhooks.
- [Home Screen & Now Playing Widgets](https://avrmaestro.com/guide/home/): The AVR Maestro Home screen: a status card, a receiver switcher and widgets you add and reorder for volume, source, sound mode, signal, Scenes, zones and HEOS.
- [Denon & Marantz App in 29 Languages](https://avrmaestro.com/guide/languages/): AVR Maestro speaks 29 languages: every screen, setting and dialog, auto-detected or chosen in Settings. Hebrew and Arabic mirror the whole layout.
- [Why a Control Is Locked: Dirac & Audyssey](https://avrmaestro.com/guide/locked-controls/): Speaker Layout, Levels or Graphic EQ locked? Your Denon or Marantz locks these menus itself, depending on whether Dirac Live or Audyssey owns the preset.
- [Multi-Room Speaker Groups: Full User Guide](https://avrmaestro.com/guide/multi-room/): Group and ungroup speakers, pick a leader, set one group volume, browse music services, search, manage the queue and keep favorites in AVR Maestro.
- [Control Zone 2 & Zone 3 From Your Phone](https://avrmaestro.com/guide/multi-zone/): Control Zone 2 and Zone 3 on Denon and Marantz receivers: power, input, volume, mute, Smart Select / Quick Select and now playing. Get AVR Maestro.
- [Navigation: Tabs, Swipes & Shortcuts](https://avrmaestro.com/guide/navigation/): Find your way around AVR Maestro: change and reorder the bottom tabs, swipe between pages, tap and long press, exit, updates and keyboard shortcuts.
- [Now Playing: Album Art and Transport](https://avrmaestro.com/guide/now-playing/): The AVR Maestro Now Playing card shows album art, track, artist and station with play, pause, next and previous, live from your Denon or Marantz.
- [Older Denon Receivers: AVR-X4000 Guide](https://avrmaestro.com/guide/older-receivers/): What AVR Maestro controls on an older Denon receiver such as the AVR-X4000: Favorites, Video Select, Network Presets, HD Radio and zone Sleep Timer.
- [On-Screen Display: Volume Readout & 21:9](https://avrmaestro.com/guide/on-screen-display/): Control your Denon or Marantz on-screen display from your phone: the volume readout position or off, the info banner, 21:9 positioning and the screen saver.
- [FM, AM & HD Radio Tuner Control From Your Phone](https://avrmaestro.com/guide/radio/): A proper FM/AM radio for Denon and Marantz receivers with a tuner: band, tune mode, frequency entry, named presets, and HD Radio on older models.
- [Manage Receivers: Add, Switch & Set Up](https://avrmaestro.com/guide/receivers/): Add a Denon or Marantz receiver to AVR Maestro, switch between receivers and set each one up: rename, change IP, Find My Receiver, locks and firmware.
- [Virtual Remote for Denon & Marantz Receivers](https://avrmaestro.com/guide/remote/): A virtual remote for Denon and Marantz receivers: D-pad, transport, renamable inputs, Smart Select / Quick Select and system controls. Get AVR Maestro.
- [Scenes: Your Whole Room, One Tap](https://avrmaestro.com/guide/scenes/): Build a one-tap Scene for movies, music, gaming or late night: input, sound mode, Audyssey or Dirac, levels and zones on Denon or Marantz. Get AVR Maestro.
- [Search: Find Any Setting Fast](https://avrmaestro.com/guide/search/): Type a setting's name in AVR Maestro and jump straight to it. Search covers every tab and every function your Denon or Marantz offers, in every app language.
- [Settings: Receivers, Look & Feel, Help & Backup](https://avrmaestro.com/guide/settings/): Every section of AVR Maestro Settings: Manage Receivers, Look and Feel (theme, Color Theme, sizes, language), Layout, Add-ons, Help, Backup and About.
- [Sound Tab: Every Audio Control on Your AVR](https://avrmaestro.com/guide/sound/): Every audio control on your Denon or Marantz explained: sound modes, Dialog Enhancer, DRC, Audyssey, Dirac Live, Graphic EQ, trims, Tone, Shape, IMAX, Auro-3D.
- [Speaker Setup: Levels, Crossovers & Presets](https://avrmaestro.com/guide/speakers/): A speaker setup workshop for your Denon or Marantz from your phone: presets, layout, Amp Assign, distances, levels, crossovers and subwoofer, older models too.
- [Volume Limit, Power-On Level & Mute Depth](https://avrmaestro.com/guide/volume/): Set a volume limit for your Denon or Marantz, choose the power-on level, pick how far Mute attenuates, and read volume as 0 to 98 or in decibels.
- [Home-Screen Widgets for Denon & Marantz](https://avrmaestro.com/guide/widgets/): AVR Maestro home-screen widgets for Android, iPhone and iPad: Quick Control, Now Playing, Receiver Status, Scenes, Multi-Room and HDMI Output. Refresh, sizes.
